subject: Authorization request: GRC headcount + compensation bands for FY24 hires
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Authorization request: GRC headcount + compensation bands for FY24 hires

Team —

Per our Q2 security roadmap and the recent SOC 2 workload increase, I am requesting approval to open two headcount slots on the GRC/security roster:

1) Senior GRC Engineer (IC4) — critical for audits and vendor controls
2) Security Engineer (IC3) — focused on automation of evidence collection and tooling

Requested compensation guidance (attached: comp_band_table_FY24.csv):
- Sr GRC Eng (IC4): target range $180,000–$205,000, comp band midpoint $192,500
- Sec Eng (IC3): target range $135,000–$155,000, comp band midpoint $145,000

Budget ask: both roles funded out of FY24 security headcount (cost center 4202). Estimated fully-burdened OTE (salary + benefits + equity planned):
- Sr GRC Eng: $235k
- Sec Eng: $170k

Immediate asks:
- Markus: please confirm alignment with org-level banding and any manager-level constraints.
- Monica: can you confirm we have capacity in 4202 for the FY24 commit and whether we should route this through normal hiring approvals or require executive sign-off?
- Evelyn: high-level sign-off on role priority so recruiting can start active sourcing.

Attachments: GRС_req_packet_Sr_GRC_ENG.pdf (job spec), comp_band_table_FY24.csv, MA_plan_draft.docx (mutual action plan skeleton for candidate onboarding + ramp).

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of People Ops (Tech Recruiting Partner)
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Authorization request: GRC headcount + compensation bands for FY24 hires

Lauren —

Thanks for the summary. A couple quick clarifications before I greenlight:

- Are these new headcount slots (net-new FTEs) or backfills? Paper trail favors new slots; need org chart update if net-new.
- For the Sr GRC Eng: is the band you listed inclusive of RSU grant expectation? If so, what’s the target equity award (4-year schedule or refresh cadence)?
- For the Sec Eng IC3: we should aim to keep first-year cash comp below the midpoint where possible to preserve comp room for the IC4 role.

If Monica confirms budget, I’m fine with moving forward with active sourcing. I’ll update the org chart and routing in Workday once we have a final cost center and band confirmation.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Authorization request: GRC headcount + compensation bands for FY24 hires

Thanks, Lauren. Per finance review:

- We have FY24 headcount capacity in cost center 4202 for two hires. This assumes no other unplanned ramp hires are approved against the same bucket.
- Recommend routing the Sr GRC Eng as a hires-with-executive-approval (salary > $195k requires EVP sign-off). Your proposed Sr target midpoint ($192.5k) is OK, but please set initial offer target at $185k for negotiation flexibility.
- Equity: propose 0.25% total package for Sr GRC Eng (4-year vest with 1-year cliff) and 0.08% for IC3; include these as ranges in the offer.
- Please supply a finalized job posting and a defensible justification document for audit (I’ll add to the hiring packet).

I’ll provisionally approve the headcount. Final funding release will be confirmed when the req is created in Workday and the job posting and comp paperwork are attached.

Monica Patel
Finance Business Partner — People
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Authorization request: GRC headcount + compensation bands for FY24 hires

Thanks Monica — noted on the $185k initial target and the exec approval threshold.

I’ve attached the updated job spec and comp table and added the recruiter (Sarah Connors / TalentBridge) so they can begin active outreach to our target list. Sarah — please prioritize candidates with SOC 2 + vendor risk program experience; target hire window is 6–8 weeks.

Candidate pipeline note: we have an inbound (passive) candidate, Jordan Smith (ex-PlatformSec at AcmeCloud). He’s indicated interest and requested a ballpark comp range. I asked to hold off on specifics until internal comp bands are finalized, but Jordan is a purple-squirrel with the right background if the numbers align.

Next steps:
- Monica: confirm when you’ll post the funding in Workday (date/time) so I can create the req.
- Markus: once posted I’ll create the req and route to you for the org approval.
- Evelyn: please reply with high-level go/no-go for priority so Lauren & recruiting can proceed.

—Lauren
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Authorization request: GRC headcount + compensation bands for FY24 hires

All —

This aligns with the prioritized workstreams and the SOC 2 remediation timeline. I approve moving forward with both reqs under the guidance Monica provided.

Actionables:
- Lauren: proceed to create the two reqs in Workday and attach the comp_band_table_FY24.csv and the job spec. Set the Sr GRC Eng initial target to $185k with a maximum offer cap of $200k pending EVP sign-off.
- Monica: please flag the reqs in Workday as approved and notify People Ops when funding posts.
- Markus: once the reqs are live, I want status updates twice weekly until hires are confirmed.

Evelyn Hart
VP, GRC & Security Compliance
Redwood Inference
